scenes.text: 147 is 3 less than which number? Let us think carefully. 147 plus 3 equals 150. The answer is 150. Great work!
84 is 7 more than which number? Let us think carefully. 84 minus 7 equals 77. The answer is 77. Great work!
235 is 10 less than which number? Let us think carefully. 235 plus 10 equals 245. The answer is 245. Great work!
320 is 5 more than which number? Let us think carefully. 320 minus 5 equals 315. The answer is 315. Great work!
